issues.description: Method calculateRemainingOrderNumber(): the problem statement (UML and description) specifies a method calculateRemainingOrderNumber() that returns an int representing the number of remaining orders. In the solution implementation (SealSaloon.java) the method is declared as public void calculateRemainingOrderNumber() and only prints order numbers instead of returning an int. This mismatch between the specified return type (int) and the implemented return type (void) will confuse students about the expected signature and cause tests or callers that expect an int to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the implementation with the specification by changing the method signature in SealSaloon.java to public int calculateRemainingOrderNumber() and return the number of remaining orders (for example: return this.orders.length). If printing a sequence of order numbers is desired for demonstration, keep the printing but also return the integer count so the method matches the problem statement and can be used by callers/tests.
